description: PAID, $0.001-$0.025 USDC. Any web page as clean, LLM-ready Markdown (boilerplate stripped) for your agent's context, e.g. url=https://example.com. Fetches the URL live (typically 1-5 s; stealth tier longer) and returns clean Markdown, JSON-LD, HTML tables and links as JSON. Tiers: cached_intel $0.001 (recent cached copy), static_scrape $0.005 (live fetch, default for normal pages), stealth_browser $0.025 (headless browser for JavaScript or Cloudflare-protected pages). An unpaid call returns the exact x402 price. Returns JSON with clean Markdown, JSON-LD, HTML tables, and links from the fetched page.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

css_selector.description: Optional CSS selector that limits extraction to one part of the page. Format: a CSS selector. Example: article. Omit to extract the whole page.

tier.description: Fetch tier. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: static_scrape. Default: auto, which picks static_scrape for a normal page. cached_intel is the recent cached copy, static_scrape is a live fetch, and stealth_browser is a headless browser. Allowed values: auto, cached_intel, static_scrape, stealth_browser.

url.description: Absolute page URL to fetch. Format: https:// host and path. Example: https://example.com. Required.

name: scrape_url
title: Scrape a URL (paid)
